perks.description:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Soulforge
perks.description: Targets afflicted by corruption from Soulfire Charges coalesce into soulfire crystals when defeated. Crystals detonate in a damaging radius when destroyed.

perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: "…Cull's death will draw those most eager to tempt Darkness. All is proceeding as we envision." —Teben Grey

catalyst.name: Soulfire Succor
catalyst.description: Destroying soulfire crystals with this weapon's frontal blades provides Soulfire Charges and partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
